name: Major Cloud, Encryption & Profile Architecture
notes: Adds personal and household finance profiles, Owner/Editor/Viewer roles, Cloud Schema V3 profile-scoped synchronization, client-side AES-256-GCM encrypted cloud payloads and backups, invitation codes, encrypted restore points, optional device app lock, MFA controls, and experimental passkeys while preserving Finance Schema 12 and the V12 Cloud Schema V2 rollback path.
